## Sales Dashboard Chart Plan

This dataset is small but rich enough to support a clean dashboard: one trend chart, one mix chart, and one composition chart. The main story is steady growth overall, with Online leading the increase.

## Best Charts and What They Reveal

### 1) Multi-line trend chart
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/graph-up.svg
- **What it shows:** Month-by-month movement for Online, InStore, and Wholesale on the same axis.
- **Why it fits:** Best for spotting growth, slowdown, and category separation over time.
- **Key insight:** Online rises consistently from 120 to 160, while InStore and Wholesale grow more modestly.

### 2) Stacked column chart
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/bar-chart.svg
- **What it shows:** Total monthly sales split into the three channels.
- **Why it fits:** Best for showing total volume and how each channel contributes to it.
- **Key insight:** Total sales increase every month, and the Online share becomes more dominant by April and May.

### 3) 100% stacked column chart
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/pie-chart.svg
- **What it shows:** The percentage mix of Online, InStore, and Wholesale each month.
- **Why it fits:** Best for tracking channel mix shifts, not raw volume.
- **Key insight:** Online gradually takes a larger proportion of the business, while InStore stays relatively stable.

### 4) Small multiples or grouped bar chart
- **What it shows:** Side-by-side comparison of channels for each month.
- **Why it fits:** Best for precise month-to-month comparison without overlap.
- **Key insight:** April is a strong month across all channels, with no category dropping sharply.

## Monthly Sales Snapshot

| Month | Online | InStore | Wholesale | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Jan | 120 | 80 | 40 | 240 |
| Feb | 135 | 78 | 44 | 257 |
| Mar | 150 | 85 | 50 | 285 |
| Apr | 160 | 90 | 52 | 302 |
| May | 155 | 92 | 55 | 302 |

## Main Insights

- **Overall growth is strong:** Total sales rise from **240** in January to **302** in April and remain there in May.
- **Online is the primary growth engine:** It increases by **40** units overall, the largest gain among the three channels.
- **InStore is stable with mild improvement:** It dips slightly in February, then climbs gradually to **92** in May.
- **Wholesale grows steadily:** Smaller base, but consistent month-over-month improvement from **40** to **55**.
- **Notable anomaly:** **May total sales flatten** at 302, even though Online softens a bit from April to May; growth in InStore and Wholesale offsets that decline.
